name: Venomous Pages
body:
School necromancy; Level sorcerer/wizard 4

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, M (a drop of snake, spider or scorpion venom)

EFFECT

Range touch
Target one touched page/level
Duration 1 hour/level
Saving Throw Fortitude negates; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

Your touch coats a number of pages equal to your level with a virulent contact poison. Anyone other than you touching the page comes into contact with the deadly toxin. The use of gloves or other protective devices adds a +4 circumstance bonus to the victim’s saving throw. The poison inflicts 1d3 points of Constitution damage per round for 6 rounds. Victims can make a Fortitude save each round to negate the damage and end the affliction.
